name: Peter Pan's Flight
sensoryNotes: Suspended dark ride flying over London and Neverland with glowing UV blacklight.
adhdTip: Continuous moving boarding belt. Very popular; aim for early rope drop or fireworks time.

name: Pirates of the Caribbean
sensoryNotes: Atmospheric boat voyage with indoor cannon fire, two mild drops, and dark water scenery.
adhdTip: Ear defenders advised during the fortress cannonade. Queue area is dark and cool.

name: Big Thunder Mountain
sensoryNotes: Fast runaway mine train with roaring track audio, sudden sharp turns, and dark tunnel plunges.
adhdTip: Queue line can echo loudly under the timber shelter. Visualise the underground tunnel drops beforehand.

name: Phantom Manor
sensoryNotes: Gothic ghost tour with stretching portrait rooms, spooky orchestrations, and glowing skeletons.
adhdTip: Pre-show room has a brief moment of complete darkness and a thunderclap scream.

name: Star Wars Hyperspace Mountain
sensoryNotes: High-speed indoor coaster with catapult launch, full inversions, lasers, and loud soundtrack.
adhdTip: High physical intensity. Best ridden when fully prepared for sensory overload and headrest vibrations.

name: it's a small world
sensoryNotes: Gentle, colourful canal cruise with singing animatronic dolls. Bright pastel lighting.
adhdTip: Repetitive catchy theme tune; ideal low-intensity sensory decompression ride.

name: Buzz Lightyear Laser Blast
sensoryNotes: Interactive laser-firing ride with joystick spin control, arcade sounds, and neon robot targets.
adhdTip: Tactile and engaging; riders can control the spinning speed of the cruiser.

name: Star Tours: The Adventures Continue
sensoryNotes: 3D motion flight simulator with hydraulic cabin movement, rapid flight drops, and blasters.
adhdTip: Take off 3D glasses if visual motion simulator nausea occurs.

name: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Peril
sensoryNotes: Outdoor mine cart coaster with a tight 360-degree inversion loop and rapid track jolts.
adhdTip: Ride is fast and relatively bumpy; check head positioning against padded restraints.

name: Blanche-Neige et les Sept Nains
sensoryNotes: Classic dark ride featuring the Evil Queen, transformation effects, and spooky haunted trees.
adhdTip: Features sudden turns and jump reveals from the Wicked Witch; can startle younger toddlers.

name: Les Voyages de Pinocchio
sensoryNotes: Wood cart dark ride detailing Stromboli's cage, Pleasure Island donkeys, and Monstro the Whale.
adhdTip: Similar pacing to Snow White; slightly dimmer lighting.

name: Dumbo the Flying Elephant
sensoryNotes: Gentle circular aerial spinner with altitude control joystick.
adhdTip: Unshaded queue; great visible overview of Fantasyland.

name: Mad Hatter's Tea Cups
sensoryNotes: Centrifugal spinning teacups under an open glass canopy.
adhdTip: Center wheel controls spin rate; you can keep the cup completely still if desired.

name: Casey Jr. – Le Petit Train du Cirque
sensoryNotes: Charming junior roller coaster through miniature fairy-tale villages.
adhdTip: Great introductory starter coaster for cautious children.

name: Le Pays des Contes de Fées
sensoryNotes: Peaceful outdoor canal cruise passing miniature Disney storybook castles.
adhdTip: Very calming; zero drops or sudden loud sounds.

name: Autopia
sensoryNotes: Petrol-powered mini race cars along a guide rail track.
adhdTip: Gasoline fumes and engine rumbling present; tactile steering.

name: Orbitron
sensoryNotes: High-altitude rotating retro rocket ships with pilot control lever.
adhdTip: Flies higher than Dumbo; great evening view of Discoveryland.

name: La Tanière du Dragon
sensoryNotes: Walkthrough cave under the castle with an enormous audio-animatronic sleeping dragon that periodically awakens and growls.
adhdTip: Self-paced walkthrough; easy to exit immediately if child feels intimidated.

name: Alice's Curious Labyrinth
sensoryNotes: Outdoor hedge maze with water fountains, singing cards, and Queen of Hearts castle lookout.
adhdTip: Great tactile space for active children to explore at their own pace.

name: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror
sensoryNotes: Accelerated vertical freefall elevator drops with stomach-floating sensations, spooky ghosts, and loud metallic sound effects.
adhdTip: Suspenseful pre-show and sudden drops. High sensory intensity.

name: Crush's Coaster
sensoryNotes: Spinning turtle shell coaster plunging through the dark East Australian Current with sharp drops.
adhdTip: Queue moves slowly. Visualise spinning in darkness before riding.

name: Ratatouille: The Adventure
sensoryNotes: Trackless 3D glasses ride with heat/cold physical blasts, water sprays, and quick scurrying motions.
adhdTip: 3D glasses can be removed if visual simulation triggers dizziness without breaking the experience.

name: Avengers Assemble: Flight Force
sensoryNotes: High-velocity inverted launch coaster with Iron Man and Captain Marvel LED screens in near-total darkness.
adhdTip: Catapult launch accelerates 0 to 60mph in under 3 seconds.

name: Spider-Man W.E.B. Adventure
sensoryNotes: Interactive 3D screen attraction requiring repetitive arm movements to sling virtual webs at Spider-Bots.
adhdTip: Highly engaging and active; great for sensory output.

name: RC Racer
sensoryNotes: Half-pipe shuttle coaster with intense vertical climbs and stomach-drop sensations.
adhdTip: Riders sit high on a steep orange track; high visual exposure.

name: Toy Soldiers Parachute Drop
sensoryNotes: Controlled parachute drop tower offering rhythmic rises, gentle drops, and panoramic views.
adhdTip: Gentle intro to drop rides before attempting Tower of Terror.

name: Slinky Dog Zigzag Spin
sensoryNotes: Circular caterpillar-style undulating ride around a giant dog bowl.
adhdTip: Low sensory stimulation; very toddler-friendly.

name: Cars ROAD TRIP
sensoryNotes: Tram tour featuring a flash flood and fire canyon demonstration with real water and heat blasts.
adhdTip: Canyon catastrophe scene creates sudden flame and loud water deluge.

name: TOGETHER: a Pixar Musical Adventure
sensoryNotes: West End-quality live indoor theatre featuring an eight-piece live orchestra, multi-sensory water droplets, and scents.
adhdTip: Comfortable indoor tiered seating; arrive 25 mins prior.

name: The Lion King: Rhythms of the Pride Lands
sensoryNotes: Acrobatic musical spectacular with high-decibel live drumming, aerialists swinging over the audience, and rich lighting.
adhdTip: Very dynamic and loud. Ear defenders recommended for sound-sensitive kids.

name: Mickey and the Magician
sensoryNotes: Broadway-style illusions with classic Disney musical numbers, dancing, and stage magic.
adhdTip: Rapid scene changes hold attention well.

name: Disney Stars on Parade
sensoryNotes: Daytime parade with loud mobile sound systems, costumed characters, and a dragon breathing fire.
adhdTip: Crowds line Main Street early. Stand near 'it's a small world' for easy departures.

name: Disney Tales of Magic Nighttime Spectacular
sensoryNotes: Castle projection show accompanied by drone swarms, laser arrays, and fireworks.
adhdTip: High crowd density. Stand toward the Main Street Train Station for a clearer exit route.
